# Optimism DEX

> Optimism DEX is a non-custodial web interface for swapping OP, ETH, USDC and USDT on Optimism, an optimistic rollup on Ethereum. Trades route through on-chain liquidity and are signed from the user's own wallet, with gas paid in ETH. Native withdrawals to Ethereum have a roughly 7-day challenge window.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Optimism DEX swaps tokens such as OP, ETH, USDC and USDT on the Optimism network.
- Optimism is an optimistic rollup on Ethereum, and gas on it is paid in ETH.
- The interface is non-custodial: users connect a wallet and sign every transaction.
- Native withdrawals from Optimism to Ethereum have a challenge window of about 7 days; swaps on Optimism are not delayed by it.
- ERC-20 sell tokens need a one-time approval; native ETH does not.
